description: Rules for RU<->EN keyboard layout correction. This config replaces flat word-pair switching with deterministic layout mapping plus language-specific scoring, protected-pattern skips, and conservative thresholds.

notes: Do not use this file as a keystroke diary or text log.
Exact word pairs are only seed boosts and tests; primary correction must be generated by keyboard layout mapping.
Short tokens are intentionally strict: false positives are worse than missed corrections.
Regex syntax is intended for ICU/NSRegularExpression.

name: Switchcraft AI conservative scoring rules
